summary: Ran every commit between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0 on the March rows of the reported ledger (a filtered copy) and found 9a04783 is the first commit giving the 2.4.0 totals, after a good parent. It changed parse_stamp in tally/dates.py to convert to UTC, and v2.4.0rc1 is the earliest tag containing it.
